$comment: Registry of repositories the jira-bug-analysis skill analyzes. Each repo is a git submodule of this repo at 'path' (relative to the repo root). 'group' is the directory (core|apps). 'hints' power target-repo inference in step 4: match against Jira components, labels, and free text. Add a repo by appending here AND to the REPOS array in scripts/setup-repos.sh, then run the setup script and commit the resulting .gitmodules change. URLs are https://github.com/... for portability; the private repos require a git environment with access to them.

repos.name: developerhub-ui

repos.name: marketplace-ui
repos.purpose: Marketplace UI — app catalog/listing, installation flow, app store surfaces inside Contentstack.

repos.name: marketplace-jsoneditor-app
